Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate.nist')
header = b'NIST_1A\n   1024\n'
fields = [
    b'channel_count -i 1\n',
    b'sample_rate -i 44100\n',
    b'sample_n_bytes -i 2\n',
    b'sample_sig_bits -i 16\n',
    b'sample_coding -s3 pcm\n',
    b'sample_byte_format -s2 01\n',
    b'end_head\n',
]
body = b''.join(fields)
body += b'\x00' * (1024 - len(header) - len(body))
assert len(header)+len(body)==1024
samples = bytes([0x01,0x02])*12345
p.write_bytes(header+body+samples)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
PY
